faq.q: Do you rent cars as well as scooters?
faq.a: Yes. There are 8 cars and pick-ups, 10 motorbikes and 17 scooters and small bikes.
Several small scooters, such as the Honda Click 125 or the Honda Scoopy, are 250 THB per day.

intro: 35 vehicles in all. Prices start at 250 THB for a small scooter and go up to 2,200 THB for a 7-seat Toyota Fortuner. Motorbikes run from 600 to 1,200 THB.
Tell us the vehicle you want and your dates, and we confirm it is free.
